concerns.text: The plan states that no verified open‑source fatigue dataset with measured residual stress exists and therefore the pipeline will run solely on deterministic synthetic data ("...ingest any open‑source fatigue dataset that satisfies the required schema (none currently exists, so the pipeline will run on the synthetic data only)" and "...bootstrap mediation analysis only if a real open dataset provides ≥ 50 rows with measured residual stress (the synthetic data is never eligible)"). Synthetic data is used only for pipeline validation, but the core research question—quantifying the mediating impact of residual stress on fatigue life—requires real measured‑stress observations. Without an appropriate real dataset, the study cannot provide empirical evidence for the hypothesis, making the chosen data resource inappropriate for the question.
